title: scHFBiMamba: a bidirectional Mamba autoencoder for cardiac disease-state classification from single-nucleus RNA-seq data
abstract: arXiv:2610.15117v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To evaluate whether a compact bidirectional state-space autoencoder improves joint classification of species, cell type, and disease state from single-nucleus RNA-sequencing profiles in heart failure (HF), while yielding interpretable gene attributions. Building on the dense denoising autoencoder (DAE) and MLP framework of Ruz Jurado et al., we developed scHFBiMamba, combining a bidirectional Mamba autoencoder (BiMambaAE) with an MLP head. BiMambaAE maps 16,545-gene profiles to 350-dimensional latent representations using 13.2M parameters, about 14.6-fold fewer than the dense DAE (192.9M). We compared six encoder-classifier configurations on 38,275 held-out cardiac nuclei using McNemar tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and assessed nine classifiers on frozen representations. Biological relevance was evaluated by comparing SHAP-derived differentially explained genes with differentially expressed genes against curated HF-related

translated_title: scHFBiMamba：一种用于从单核RNA测序数据进行心脏疾病状态分类的双向Mamba自编码器
translated_abstract: 为了评估紧凑的双向状态空间自编码器能否改进对心力衰竭（HF）单核RNA测序图谱中物种、细胞类型和疾病状态的联合分类，同时提供可解释的基因归因。在Ruz Jurado等人的密集去噪自编码器（DAE）和MLP框架基础上，我们开发了scHFBiMamba，将双向Mamba自编码器（BiMambaAE）与MLP分类头相结合。BiMambaAE仅使用1320万参数将16,545个基因的图谱映射到350维潜在表示，参数量比密集DAE（1.929亿）少约14.6倍。我们在38,275个保留的心脏细胞核上使用经Benjamini-Hochberg校正的McNemar检验比较了六种编码器-分类器配置，并在冻结的表示上评估了九种分类器。通过将SHAP导出的差异解释基因与差异表达基因及经整理的心衰相关基因库进行对比，评估了模型的生物学相关性。
tldr: scHFBiMamba提出了一种紧凑的双向Mamba自编码器，以比传统密集DAE少约14.6倍的参数量实现心力衰竭单核RNA测序数据中物种、细胞类型和疾病状态的联合分类，同时提供可解释的基因归因。
en_tdlr: scHFBiMamba introduces a compact bidirectional Mamba autoencoder that jointly classifies species, cell type, and disease state from heart failure single-nucleus RNA-seq data with 14.6-fold fewer parameters than dense DAEs while yielding interpretable gene attributions.
